name: festival

emotion_styles.joy: vibrant lantern glow, lively festive energy
emotion_styles.love: soft lantern light, intimate festival evening

stages.name: 祭りの灯
stages.description: 提灯が夜の始まりを告げる
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, Japanese summer festival street glowing with paper lanterns, colorful stalls, lively atmosphere

stages.name: 縁日の賑わい
stages.description: 屋台と人々の笑顔が広がる
stages.prompt: anime illustration, traditional festival food stalls, warm lantern light, joyful candid moments, detailed setting

stages.name: 神楽の舞
stages.description: 太鼓と笛に合わせて舞う
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, traditional shrine dance at a summer festival, flowing garments, dramatic lantern lighting

stages.name: 夜空の花火
stages.description: 花火が夜空を鮮やかに染める
stages.prompt: cinematic anime illustration, enormous colorful fireworks above a river, glowing reflections, silhouettes watching in wonder

stages.name: 祭りのあと
stages.description: 静かな夜に余韻が残る
stages.prompt: poetic anime illustration, quiet festival street after the crowd has left, a few glowing lanterns, wistful midnight atmosphere

character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the festival world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in traditional festival street, riverside fireworks viewing, shrine grounds; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with lantern amber, crimson, indigo, gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by lantern-level tracking shot, wide fireworks shot, close-up festival details; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
